## Cloudflare seeks to raise $2.175 billion via convertible note offering

A convertible of this size signals an aggressive growth investment from Cloudflare; for a PM long NET, the key watch items are use of proceeds and conversion terms — a large raise without a near-term revenue catalyst visible in the headlines can create overhang risk.

- Cloudflare is marketing a $2.175 billion convertible note offering.
- The raise is consistent with funding platform expansion or AI security infrastructure investment.
- Convertible notes introduce potential future dilution; conversion terms not disclosed in the headlines.
- Two outlets in agreement on size and structure.
